name: Insightly
description: Insightly is a powerful CRM and project management tool designed to help businesses manage customer relationships, track sales, and streamline project workflows. With Insightly, you can easily organize and manage your contacts, leads, and opportunities, as well as collaborate with your team on projects and tasks.
